rationale: Adds pulp-host-lane-probe under tools/editor-open (plus its wrapper, registry entry and two ctest registrations): a development probe that loads built plug-in bundles into one host process and records load, audio, editor lifecycle read-back and the dyld image census for the Vellum parity host lane. It reads existing Pulp host APIs only; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, packaging or plug-in output changes, and no authority moves between Pulp and Vellum.
